output_video_heygen.description: AI avatar video via HeyGen API (scaffold — build_videos raises NotImplementedError for non-kokoro providers)

web_ui.description: FastAPI web interface with drag-drop upload (PDF and PPTX), format selection, real-time progress, and video generation via Kokoro TTS

pptx_upload.description: PPTX file upload support alongside PDF — magic byte validation (PK\x03\x04 ZIP header), drop zone and file input updated, /api/start discovers both .pdf and .pptx files

authentication.description: bcrypt session auth on all protected routes

evaluation_framework.description: L1 structural + L2 LLM judge evaluation suite with A/B comparison CLI

chromadb_rag.description: ChromaDB vector store with local embeddings for curriculum context

docker_deployment.description: Docker containerisation (main CPU image + GPU image + CPU-video image)

gcp_cloud_run.description: GCP Cloud Run 3-service deployment (CPU pipeline + GPU video primary + CPU video fallback)

gpu_service.description: GPU microservice for video rendering — Kokoro TTS + ffmpeg on NVIDIA L4, GCS data transfer, identity token auth. Tier 1 and Tier 2 in the 3-tier fallback chain.

cpu_video_service.description: CPU-only video microservice — Kokoro TTS + ffmpeg libx264 on 8 vCPU / 32 GiB Cloud Run (europe-west2). Tier 3 fallback when both GPU tiers are unreachable. Same API contract as gpu_service. Supports graceful cancellation at phase boundaries.

three_tier_video_fallback.description: VideoServiceClient (backend/services/gpu_client.py) routes video jobs across 3 tiers: GPU Primary (europe-west4) → GPU Fallback (europe-west1) → CPU Video (europe-west2). Fallback triggers on infrastructure failures only (ConnectionError, Timeout, 5xx). See docs/adr/ADR-001-three-tier-video-fallback.md.

agent_readiness_setup.description: Claude Code agentic scaffolding (AGENTS.md, skills, hooks, rules)

video_pipeline_kokoro.description: Open-source video pipeline via Kokoro TTS + MoviePy (parallel to HeyGen) — E2E tested. Video checkbox enabled in UI with Kokoro TTS label.

quiz_platform.description: Interactive quiz platform with React frontend + Neon PostgreSQL + JWT auth

admin_dashboard.description: Admin dashboard with analytics, feedback loop, and data tracking

langsmith_integration.description: LangSmith observability — v0.4: @traceable on all video services (build_videos, _build_kokoro_video, _build_kokoro_videos) + tts_engine, script_parser, file_parser; console logging via logging.basicConfig(); opt-in tracing, job metadata; v0.5+: Prompt Hub, Datasets, Annotation Queues

content_viewers.description: React SPA content viewers — inline PDF iframe, PPT slide carousel with keyboard navigation, HTML5 video player with topic selector. Five backend view endpoints in frontend/view_routes.py (pdf, slides, slide/{index}, videos, video/{index}). Zero new npm dependencies.

path_traversal_security_fix.description: CWE-23 path traversal fix on view endpoints — job_id validated against JOB_ID_RE (8-char hex), file paths resolved with Path.resolve() and checked against outputs root before serving. Returns HTTP 400 on boundary escape.
